infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RimSocial uses the camera so you can take photos and record videos to share in posts, stories and messages.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: RimSocial uses the microphone so you can record video sound and voice messages.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: RimSocial accesses selected photos and videos so you can share them in posts, stories and messages.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: RimSocial saves photos and videos you choose to export to your photo library.
